description:
Execute a QuickBooks SQL-like query selecting from `Account`.

Example:
  SELECT * FROM Account STARTPOSITION 1 MAXRESULTS 5

parameters.name: realmId
parameters.description: QuickBooks company ID returned as `realmId` during OAuth authorisation.

parameters.name: minorversion
parameters.description: Optional Intuit minor version. Intuit retires older minor versions over time, so pin only when you need specific behaviour.

parameters.name: query
parameters.description: SQL-like QuickBooks query statement selecting from `Account`.
